prompt: I want to make a login page for a SaaS product. Show me 3 style directions to compare
expected: First run the three kickoff steps (learn / ledger / capabilities); ask only one round of questions and ask for references; each of the three logics produces two candidates, six direction cards in total (real-world references screenshotted with ref_board.py, the roulette looks at the specimen images first); after the six-cell thumbnails, pick three to build as full HTML + screenshots (don't crowd one family, don't collide with the look ledger, at most one that tries too hard), design_lint compare shows no collisions; lay out the three full versions together with the thumbnail alternates and stop
tests: three-direction gate + pick three of six candidates + reference board and specimens + compare and look ledger self-check

prompt: Make me a 10-slide product pitch deck about an AI tool startup
expected: Each of the three directions produces 2 representative slides (cover + the slide that differs most), with the deck shell using the assets/deck_index.html multi-file overview wall; lay them out and stop; once one is chosen, set the 2-slide showcase grammar first, then batch; body ≥24px, labels ≥16px; individual slides don't carry their own page numbers; automatically export a PDF when done
tests: three-direction gate + deck module delivery chain + multi-file architecture + type size floor

prompt: Make a 30-second HTML animation explaining how neural networks work
expected: Use Stage+Sprite from animations.jsx; write the timeline first, then the components; easeOut for entrances, easeIn for exits; tell the story in phases instead of piling on animations; text stays on screen ≥3 seconds
tests: animations workflow + correct easing + pacing design + duration control

prompt: Make a Habit Tracker App prototype
expected: Ask the user whether they want an overview spread or a flow demo (overview by default); use assets/ios_frame.jsx, don't hand-write the Dynamic Island; a Tracker is the high-density type, with ≥ 3 information-density elements per screen (habit completion rate, streak days, trend curve, achievement badges, etc., not decoration); at least 5-7 screens side by side (home/new habit/details/stats/settings)
tests: overview/flow form routing + ios_frame hard binding + information density typing (high-density type) + multiple screens side by side

prompt: Make a reading notes App prototype
expected: Mainly an overview spread; ios_frame.jsx; reading notes lean toward content display, so the information density requirement is less extreme than a Tracker, but the notes list page still needs ≥ 3 layers of information (book, quote, tags, progress); at least 4-6 screens (home bookshelf/note details/annotation highlights/search/notebook management); prefer a serif display font
tests: overview default + ios_frame + information hierarchy + content-first visual rhythm

prompt: Make a running log App prototype
expected: Overview spread; ios_frame.jsx; a running App is the high-density type (map, pace curve, heart rate zones, per-kilometer split data), with ≥ 3 pieces of product-differentiating information per screen; at least 5 screens (today's overview/live data during a run/route map/history/monthly stats); avoid AI slop (no purple gradients, no piles of decorative icons, but data visualization icons may stay)
tests: overview + ios_frame + high-density data visualization + mixed map/chart layout + slop boundary conditions
